SECTIONS  snetwork SECTION [ITEM]
  interfaces [NAME]   every interface, the default route first
  subnets             networks you sit on, and those a VPN reaches; default routes
  devices [SUBNET]    devices per subnet, with names and makers; a subnet behind
                      the tailnet is asked of the peer that routes it
  dhcp [NAME]         lease, server, router and DNS, and time left
  dns                 resolvers in the order the system asks them
  wifi                band, channel, width, signal, rate; --active: networks nearby
  vpn [PEER]          Tailscale peers and routes; other VPNs
  internet            --active only: public addresses, carrier-grade NAT, latency
  firewall            the macOS application firewall and pf; ufw and nftables
  listening           TCP ports that accept connections from other machines
  all                 every section in full

NAMES  strongest first
  your ssh config (Host with a HostName address), Tailscale, known_hosts,
  and with --active the router's DNS, then mDNS. One machine with two
  addresses on one subnet shows once.

NOTES
  devices   without --active: what this machine talked to lately, not a scan.
  wifi      macOS hides the network name from the terminal. A Shortcut
            called "Wi-Fi name" (Get Network Details → Network Name) shows it.
  firewall  rules need root, so snetwork does not read them.
